title: Start easy, then raise difficulty in steps
statement: Open a course with material students can handle and raise its difficulty in steps.
example: One course ramps through three bands of reading level, starting at 400 to 460 on a reading-level scale.
detail: At a team sync on the reading course, its opening was found too hard, and the decision was to start easier and calibrate up (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0057-incept-team-sync-2-2026-06-18.qmd`). The course structure ramps band by band: a hook band at 400-460L, a bridge band at 480-540L and a transfer band at 560-600L (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0014-course-structure-manifest.qmd`).

evidence.quote: **Lexile start too hard** — course opens on "vertebrates and invertebrates"; start easier and calibrate up.
